name: JANUS SIT2D — Archived Physical Profile Donor Verification
question: Does the exact prior JANUS R41S1H1 cross-validated physical narrow-vs-broad morphology + repeated ON/OFF contrast recover weak artificial drifting lines on authentic measured GBT backgrounds at fixed false-control rate, beyond strong direct ON/OFF matched evidence and the original donor fixed-Gaussian comparator?

archive_audit.donor_functions: templates(), role_score(), score() byte-exact transplanted, no changes to donor source
archive_audit.original_R41_scope: Preregistered synthetic four-role physical Gaussian source model, not previously validated for 3I/ATLAS, full detection, or astrophysical true positive classes

rejected_injection_methods.R26_envelope: Prior reference-shift failure with >140 false alerts; do not auto-deploy
rejected_injection_methods.R30_shield: Prior reduction in control alerts lost weak true injections; not safe
rejected_injection_methods.R40K_joint: Prior stationary rescue produced excess 43 controls against 35, not yet vetted

real_radio.dev: Previously inspected X receiver blc20 0061–0066 with exact SHA256 from SIT1, never use for fresh independent discovery claims
real_radio.evaluation: Previously untested blc22 receiver 0013–0018 (source file names verified in official catalog); label receiver using physical fch1 from real HDF5, not assumptions from prefix
real_radio.file_format: rawspec.0002.h5 279×1×65536 expected; 16×128 real measured panels 4 windows/scan by pinned SIT1 source decoder
real_radio.truth_limit: Nominal ON/OFF archive labels and measured HDF5 header direction, no independent antenna tracking/ephemerides or real sky emission class.
real_radio.independence: Only a new receiver/cadence, same telescope, date and target, not independent external replication.
real_radio.preservation: No original HDF5 mutation or changes to production COSMOS.

study.roles: All combinations of two nominal ON scans from three and their paired two nominal OFF scans (3 overlapping role groups ×4 frequency windows =12 base four-role examples for each receiver).
study.source_frequency_tracks: Known injected path is concealed from candidate selector/donor score and only used by evaluator.
study.blinded_path_selector: Identical for all arms: full registered R42A8A 672 linear hypotheses on mean of two ON measured/perturbed panels, restricted to path bins 24..103 to permit exact 49-channel H1 support; no oracle access.
study.donor_adaptation: After blind track selection, extract 49 original frequency channels around each selected path separately for both ON and paired OFF observations. This is a de-drift coordinate transformation shared with direct comparator. Apply exact donor score() and its fixed control, same measured bandwidth and data.
study.source_format_assertion: All six scans in a receiver must share identical physical fch1/foff and 16x128 output geometry; fail closed, no interpolation.
study.sideband_strong_direct: For identical selected track, per-time row median/MAD normalized center minus p±3 sidebands, min of both ON evidences minus max(0,both paired OFF evidences).
study.four_role_donor_fixed: Original R41S1H1 score() returns physical vs fixed Gaussian model; fixed score acts as separate comparator.
study.more_exhaustive_competitor: Same 672 hypothesis search bank used for path selection in all arms; original native ridge score included as contextual diagnostic only.
study.transposed_TACHYON: Pinned R5F graph traces the selected H1 outcome C→B→A and independent forward reexecution; cannot alter candidate track or donor score and gain must be zero vs same-objective direct H1.

gates.threshold: Frozen p95 per arm on X development synthetic no-injection / engineered shared-RFI controls; no eval receiver score used for fit.
gates.strong_positive_pass: >=32/36 synthetic strong injections correctly localized and score strictly above development cutoff
gates.weak_gain_over_strong_direct: >=4 more of 36 weak injection cases than direct 4-role contrast and donor fixed score, with no extra control exceedances; donor cross-validation cost counted.
gates.TACHYON_specific_gain: Compare identical physical donor score direct and reverse provenance; any gain beyond direct must be separately demonstrated (not expected).
